name: CM33_lifted_code_is_the_cards
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (REA-style distillation kept internal; native through the language cards)
statement: Lifted ROM code is the instruction cards' IR specialised to the ROM's bytes (inlining, constant propagation, register caching, dead code), emitted through a language card; a block runs only when it can finish before the next event and leaves after any write that may move one, so a lifted run is frame-for-frame identical to the interpreter; a planted change in a lifted block is caught by the differential run; ROM-derived code stays in the state cache, never in the repository.
